clips.title: The story
paras: Across Teldrassil, Timberling Seeds are gathered from plant spirits that have grown hostile. Naturalists and druids study them to learn why the forest's plant life has turned aggressive.

Timberlings are nature elementals of Teldrassil, and their temper reflects the World Tree's balance. Lately they have grown hostile and angry, troubling the night elves who tend the boughs. Herbalists such as Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth suspect trouble in the soil. They gather seeds from wild timberlings, hoping that purified, carefully tended soil might let docile offspring sprout.
